purpose: Forecast quality/freshness signal changes after CP5 corruption; compare against baseline_signals.json.

forecast.expected_direction: row_count decreases by 2 before other mutations; latest_published becomes older than baseline 2026-08-05
forecast.likely_metric_impact: Low for current locked test set: drop candidates do not overlap locked ground_truth_doc_ids

forecast.expected_direction: summary_not_null and summary_min_length flip to fail; overall quality.passed -> false
forecast.likely_metric_impact: If a blanked paper is retrieved for summary questions, token_f1/judge drop

forecast.expected_direction: Basic null/length checks may still pass; embedding text becomes noisy
forecast.likely_metric_impact: Possible retrieval/answer degradation without failing quality gates

forecast.expected_direction: title remains non-empty so title_not_null still passes
forecast.likely_metric_impact: Exact title lookup in qa.py may miss; retrieval_hit_rate / token_f1 can fall for title-based questions

forecast.expected_direction: shift_days=400 > freshness_threshold_days=180 => stale_rows >= 2, is_fresh -> false, max_age_days rises
forecast.likely_metric_impact: Mostly observability signal; answer metrics change only if date questions depend on corrupted published metadata

forecast.expected_direction: paper_id_unique fails; row_count increases by 2 relative to post-drop frame
forecast.likely_metric_impact: Index/doc counts inflate; uniqueness audit fails

summary_expectation_after_full_corruptio.evaluation_rule: Reuse locked test_set.json only; do not set REFRESH_TEST_SET=true
